source: FlightTempo route policy and machine-readable conflict-zone advisory datasets
notes: airspace_filter.json combines EASA advisory records with OpenAIP FIR geometry references. It does not contain a complete legal prohibition feed. See per-source metadata in airspace/advisories and navigation/airspace. EASA Minsk Safety Directives are maintained separately under airspace/advisories and are not a universal no-fly rule.
